spec_match.rationale: Exercises the [EnforceRange] unsigned short? IDL contract the spec declares: 0/12/100/65535 stored, 65536/-1 TypeError, null = no hint, plus the setter's identical range.

interactive.rationale: Two buttons run the boundary matrix and the setter test against real constructor/attribute calls; every table row is a real outcome.

blurb_alignment.rationale: Blurb promises stored/thrown/ignored per value; the page reports exactly that per row.

edge_cases.rationale: The page IS the edge-case portfolio; the unsupported branch is first-class — unread members are shown as 'ignored' and explicitly not range-tested rather than fake-passing.

runtime_evidence.rationale: Headless Chromium 141 via repo CDP harness: honest not-read/absent/ignored branches fully exercised with clean consoles and screenshots on both classes. Partial, not pass: the supported Chrome 158+ path — hints read, stored, EnforceRange throwing — could not be run on this build; it stays pinned by the conformance suite and the open question.

accessibility.rationale: Native buttons, caption/scope on the table, aria-live summary outputs.

references.rationale: Every page links https://chromestatus.com/feature/5089961022980096 plus the spec configuration section.

conformance.rationale: New 9-assertion suite probes the exact members: getter-observed dictionary read, 400 round-trip, EnforceRange TypeErrors for 65536/-1, null round-trip, and writable attribute gated on prototype presence; verified executing 1 pass / 8 honest fails on pre-158 Chromium 141.

telemetry_health.rationale: showcaseTelemetry.assert covers probe consistency, constructor outcomes, input rejection, raise round-trip; consoles clean on both classes.

design_system.rationale: CSS variables only, button background+color overridden together, WCAG AA pairs (charcoal/stone, emerald/rose on paper).

mobile_desktop_parity.rationale: Repo harness (mobile 360×740 DPR3 + desktop 1280×800): zero horizontal overflow, zero console errors, screenshots read; sub-44px items are the standard sitewide reference links.

openQuestions.title: Confirm the TypeError rows on Chrome 158+
openQuestions.detail: On a 158+ build 65536 and -1 must throw TypeError and null must round-trip; only the ignored branch was observable on Chromium 141. The conformance suite pins the same contract.

guidanceConsulted.query: accessible live status readout for async API probe result
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Use a single polite live region per changing status surface; announce meaningful results, not interstitial noise; keep labels programmatic.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Each page routes its changing verdict/readback text through one aria-live=polite <output> per surface; no loading-spam announcements; all controls are native buttons/inputs with <label for> associations.

guidanceConsulted.query: responsive form controls number input touch targets no horizontal overflow
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Visible labels above controls associated via for/id, aria-describedby for help text, inputmode=numeric for numeric fields instead of type=number where scroll/wheel side effects hurt, 44px minimum targets.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Tuner inputs use type=text + inputmode=numeric with visible labels and aria-describedby range hints; buttons are min-height 44px; long identifier tokens use overflow-wrap:anywhere/word-break:break-all so no horizontal overflow at 360px (verified 0px on both classes).

summary: Boundary matrix for the [EnforceRange] unsigned short? contract with an honest ignored-member story on pre-158 builds. Verified with the repo headless-Chrome CDP harness: matrix and setter driven by real API calls, clean console, zero overflow both classes.
